follow-up time: From birth until discharge from hospital
finding: Newborns born to mothers with COVID-19 were more likely to be born by cesarean delivery, born prematurely, have low birth weight, and experience neonatal respiratory distress syndrome, oxygen requirement, need for intensive care, and breastfeeding problems.
mod_finding: Newborns born to mothers with COVID-19 were more likely to be born by cesarean delivery.
